“nAn2 èn2 ir2aivan2ughghu mAr2u jhèydhAl, maghadhdhAn2a nALil (er2bhaDhuM) vedhan2aiyai nAn2 nijhjhayamAgha bhayabhbhaDhughir2en2” èn2r2u ghUr2uvIrAgha.
“annALil èvaròruvar andha vedhan2aiyai viDhDhuM vilaghghabhbhaDhuvAro, nijhjhayamAgha (allAh) avarmIdhu ghirubhai bhurindhuviDhDhAn2. idhu mighadh dhèLivAn2a vèr2r2iyAghuM” (èn2r2u ghUr2uvIrAgha).

“(nabhiye!) allAh umaghghu edhAvadhòru dhun2bhadhdhai er2bhaDhudhdhiviDhDhAl avan2aidh dhavira (ver2u yAruM) adhai nIghgha muDhiyAdhu. in2n2uM avan2 òru nan2maiyai uNDhAghghiviDhDhAl, (adhai èvaruM dhaDhughgha muDhiyAdhu.) avan2 èllAbh bhòruDhghaL mIdhuM bherAr2r2aluDhaiyavan2Agha irughghin2r2An2.
avan2e dhan2 aDhiyArghaLai aDhaghghiyALbhavan2, in2n2uM avan2e bhUraNa JAn2amuLLavan2; (yAvar2r2aiyuM) nan2ghar2indhavan2.

(nabhiye!) “jhADhjhiyadhdhil mighavuM bhèriyadhu èdhu?” èn2agh gheLuM; “allAhve èn2aghghuM uGghaLughghumiDhaiye jhADhjhiyAgha irughghin2r2An2; indha ghurAn2 èn2aghghu vahIyAgha aruLabhbhaDhDhuLLadhu. idhaigh ghòNDhu uGghaLaiyuM, (idhai aDhaindhavarghaLaiyuM nAn2 ajhjhamUDhDhi èjhjharibhbhadhar2ghAgha; nijhjhayamAgha vaNaghghadhdhir2ghuriya ver2u dhèyvaGghaLuM allAhvuDhan2 irubhbhadhAgha nIGghaL jhADhjhi ghUr2amuDhiyumA? (èn2r2u avariDhaM gheDhbhIrAgha) “illai! nAn2 (avvAr2u) jhADhjhi jhòlla muDhiyAdhu èn2r2uM ghUr2uvIrAgha; vaNaghghadhdhir2ghuriyavan2 nijhjhayamAgha avan2 òruvan2 dhAn2; avan2ughghu nIGghaL iNaivaibhbhadhilirundhu nAn2 nijhjhayamAgha vilaghigh ghòNDhavan2e” èn2r2u ghUr2iviDhuM.

èvaruM dhaM ghuzhandhaighaLai (jhandheghamillAmal ar2ivadhaibh bhol, vedhaG ghòDhughghabh bhèr2r2avarghaL, (naM dhUdharAghiya ivarai, ir2aivan2uDhaiya dhUdhar dhAM) èn2r2u nan2ghar2ivArghaL. èvarghaL dhamaghghudh dhAme naSDhamizhaidhdhugh ghòNDhArghaLo avarghaL dhAM ivarai naMbhamADhDhArghaL.

allAh mIdhu bhòyyaigh ghar2bhan2ai jhèyghir2avan2ai viDha, alladhu avan2uDhaiya vajhan2aGghaLaibh bhòyyAghghughir2avan2ai viDha aniyAyaghghAran2 yAr? nijhjhayamAgha aniyAyagh ghArarghaL vèr2r2i bhèr2ave mADhDhArghaL.
avarghaL an2aivaraiyuM nAM òn2r2u jherghghuM nALil namaghghu iNaivaidhdhavarghaLai noghghi, ”nIGghaL (allAhvughghu iNaiyAgha vaidhdha) uGghaLuDhaiya andhagh ghUDhDhALighaL èGghe” èn2r2u gheDhbhoM.
“èGghaL rabhbhAghiya allAhvin2 mIdhu ANaiyAgha, nAGghaL iNaivaibhbhavarghaLAgha irundhadhillai” èn2r2u ghUr2uvadhaidh dhavira ver2u avarghaLuDhaiya bhadhil èdhuvuM irAdhu.

(nabhiye!) avarghaL dhaGghaLughghu èdhirAgha èvvAr2u bhòy ghUr2igh ghòNDhArghaL èn2bhadhaibh bhAruM; An2Al (ir2aivan2ughghu iNaiyAn2avai èn2r2u avarghaL bhòyyAghagh) ghar2bhan2ai jhèydhadhèllAM (avarghaLughghu udhaviDhAdhu) mar2aindhuviDhuM.

avarghaLil jhilar uM bhejhjhaigh gheDh(bhadhu bhol bhAvan2ai jhèy)ghin2r2an2ar; nAM avarghaLuDhaiya uLLaGghaLil adhai viLaGghigh ghòLLAdhu irughghumAr2u dhiraighaLaiyuM in2n2uM avarghaL ghAdhughaLil jhèviDhDhudh dhan2maiyuM er2bhaDhudhdhin2oM; in2n2uM avarghaL èllA adhdhADhjhighaLaiyuM bhArdhdhAluM avar2r2ai naMbhamADhDhArghaL; in2n2uM ivarghaL uMmiDhaM vandhAl uMmoDhu vAdhADhuvArghaL; “ivaiyèllAM mun2n2orghaLuDhaiya ghaDhDhugh ghadhaighaLeyan2r2i ver2illai” èn2r2u innirAgharibhbhor ghUr2uvArghaL.

meluM avarghaL (bhir2araiyuM) adhai (gheDhghaviDhAdhu) dhaDhughghir2ArghaL; ivarghaLuM adhaiviDhDhu òdhuGghigh ghòLghir2ArghaL; avarghaL dhaGghaLaidh dhAGghaLe nAjhamAghghigh ghòLghir2ArghaL; An2Al avarghaL (idhaibh) bhurindhu ghòLvadhillai.

naragha nèrubhbhin2mun2 avarghaL nir2udhdhabhbhaDhuMbhodhu (nabhiye!) nIr avarghaLaibh bhArbhbhIrAyin2, “èGghaL gheDhe! nAGghaL dhiruMbha (ulaghadhdhir2ghu) an2ubhbhaDhDhAl (nalamAgha irughghume) abhbhòzhudhu nAGghaL èGghaLin2 ir2aivan2in2 adhdhADhjhighaLaibh bhòybhbhighgha mADhDhoM; nAGghaL muHmin2ghaLAgha irubhbhoM” èn2agh ghUr2uvadhaigh ghANbhIr.

èn2in2uM, èdhai ivarghaL mun2bhu mar2aidhdhirundhArghaLo adhu ivarghaLughghu vèLibhbhaDhDhu viDhDhadhu; ivarghaL (ulaghadhdhir2ghudh) dhirubhbhi an2ubhbhabhbhaDhDhAluM èdhai viDhDhu avarghaL dhaDhughghabhbhaDhDhArghaLo adhar2ghe mILuvArghaL; nijhjhayamAgha avarghaL bhòyyarghaLe.

an2r2iyuM, “ivvulaghadhdhil nAM vAzhndhirubhbhadhaidh dhavira (abhbhAl mar2umai vAzhvu èn2r2u) òn2r2uM illai; nAM (maraNadhdhir2ghubh bhin2 mar2ubhaDhiyuM) èzhubhbhabh bhaDha mADhDhoM” èn2r2uM avarghaL ghUr2ughin2r2an2ar.

ivarghaL (uyirbhbhighghabhbhaDhDhu) ivarghaLuDhaiya ir2aivan2in2 mun2 nir2udhdhabhbhaDhuMbhodhu ivarghaLai nIr ghANbhIrAyin2 (adhu jhamayaM ir2aivan2 gheDhbhAn2) idhu uNmaiyallavA? èn2r2u; ”AM! èGghaLuDhaiya rabhbhin2 mIdhu ANaiyAgha (mèydhAn2)” èn2r2u ivarghaL ghUr2uvArghaL; abhbhodhu, “nIGghaL nirAgharidhdhugh ghòNDhirundha ghAraNadhdhAl vedhan2aiyai an2ubhaviyuGghaL” èn2r2u allAh ghUr2uvAn2.

Aghave, (mar2umai nALil) allAhvaijh jhandhibhbhadhaibh bhòy èn2r2u ghUr2iyavarghaL nijhjhayamAgha naSDhaM aDhaindhavarghaLAghi viDhDhan2ar; avarghaLiDhaM mar2umai nAL dhiDhIrèn2a varuMbhòzhudhu ulaghil nAGghaL alaDhjhiyamAy irundhadhar2ghAgha èGghaLughghu er2bhaDhDha ghai jhedhame èn2r2u ghUr2uvArghaL. meluM avarghaL dhaGghaL (bhAvajh) jhumaighaLai dhaGghaL mudhughughaLin2 mel jhumabhbhArghaL; avarghaL jhumabhbhadhu mighavuM ghèDhDhadhu èn2bhadhai ar2indhugh ghòLLuGghaL.

An2Al èvar naM dhiruvajhan2aGghaLaibh bhòybhbhighghir2ArghaLo avarghaLai avarghaL jhèydhu varuM bhAvaGghaLin2 ghAraNamAgha vedhan2aibh bhiDhidhdhugh ghòLLuM.

(nabhiye!) nIr ghUr2uM| “èn2n2iDhadhdhil allAhvin2 bhòghghiSaGghaL irughghin2r2an2a èn2r2u nAn2 uGghaLiDhaM ghUr2avillai. mar2aivAn2avar2r2ai nAn2 ar2iyamADhDhen2; nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 òru malaghghAgha irughghin2r2en2 èn2r2uM nAn2 uGghaLiDhaM jhòllavillai; èn2aghghu (vahIyAgha) ar2ivighghabhbhaDhDhadhaidh dhavira (ver2u èdhaiyuM) nAn2 bhin2bhar2r2avillai.” in2n2uM nIr ghUr2uM| “ghuruDhan2uM bhArvaiyuDhaiyavan2uM jhamamAvArA? nIGghaL jhindhighgha veNDhAmA?”

namaghghiDhaiyil (ezhaighaLAghiya) ivarghaL mIdhA allAh aruLbhurindhu viDhDhAn2? èn2r2u (jhèlvandharghaL) ghUr2a veNDhumèn2bhadhar2ghAgha avarghaLil jhilarai jhilaraighghòNDhu nAM ivvAr2u jhodhidhdhoM. nan2r2i jhèludhdhubhavarghaLai allAh migha ar2indhavan2illaiyA?

“nAGghaL un2n2ai adhighamadhighaM (dhasbhIhu jhèydhu) dhudhibhbhadhar2ghAghavuM;
“un2n2ai adhighamadhighaM nin2aivu ghUrvadhar2ghAghavuM (ivar2r2aiyèllAM aruLvAyAgha!)
“nijhjhayamAgha, nI èGghaLai noghghiyavan2Aghave irughghir2Ay” (èn2r2Ar)
“mUsAve! nIr gheDhDhavai, nijhjhayamAgha umaghghugh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhirughghin2r2an2a” èn2r2u (allAh) ghUr2in2An2.
